summary: 5 V to 3.3 V power board with input/output connectors, fixed 3.3 V LDO, and green power indicator LED with current-limiting resistor.
purpose: Step down 5 V to 3.3 V with low dropout, provide regulated 3.3 V output, and indicate power status via LED.
constraints: Green LED on 3.3 V rail, current ~2 mA

required.detail: Green, power indicator, on 3.3 V rail
